caption: A low-angle close-up frames an illuminated ceiling lamp against a featureless black background. The white, glossy dome shade appears as an oval, with a dark socket ring at its center and a warm-white bulb glowing below it. A faint diagonal shadow streak and a small bright reflection near the shade's upper edge persist throughout. The shade drifts and tilts, sliding from a centered position toward the left, then moving right-of-center and higher, while the oval's elongation changes with the shifting viewing angle. Motion blur rises and falls intermittently, marking ongoing relative movement across the view. The bulb stays lit and attached to the socket, its offset from the ring varying as the angle changes. No part separates or disappears against the uniform darkness.
relations: The glossy dome shade tilts and shifts laterally, elongating its oval outline and repositioning it against the black background.
The lit bulb stays attached below the socket ring, its apparent offset varying as the viewing angle changes.
The diagonal shadow streak and upper-edge reflection persist on the moving shade, modulating with its tilt.
Motion blur intermittently rises and falls as the shade slides left then right-of-center, marking relative movement.
